items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: "I Wish I Could Shimmy Like My Sister Kate" ... Those were the numbers that was more or less popular

ctx.x: there couldn't have been much jazz. You see the thing is, the point is, I mentioned this number, "I Wish I Could Shimmy Like My Sister Kate," and, "How Are You Gonna Keep Them Down on the Farm," and things like that.
Those were the numbers that was more or less popular, you see, popular numbers. When we played at the dance school, we played them as one-steps.
